lines.style: Speak English as a Japanese beginner who learned it from textbooks: katakana-like vowels added after consonants, flat syllable-by-syllable timing, every syllable equally stressed. Talking about her day at an ordinary speaking pace, not slow: one short hesitant pause after "Yesterday", then "I go to cafe" said plainly. About two seconds in total. Keep it natural, not a caricature.

lines.text: Yesterday, I went to a cafe.
